legal_units.title: Meaning of associated enterprise.
legal_units.text: For the purposes of this Chapter, the expression "associated enterprise", in relation to another enterprise, means an enterprise—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 162 Meaning of associated enterprise. Section 162(1): For the purposes of this Chapter, the expression "associated enterprise", in relation to another enterprise, means an enterprise—

legal_units.title: Meaning of associated enterprise.
legal_units.text: which participates, directly or indirectly, or through one or more intermediaries, in the management or control or capital of the other enterprise in the following manner,—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 162 Meaning of associated enterprise. Section 162(1): For the purposes of this Chapter, the expression "associated enterprise", in relation to another enterprise, means an enterprise— Section 162(1)(a): which participates, directly or indirectly, or through one or more intermediaries, in the management or control or capital of the other enterprise in the following manner,—

legal_units.title: Meaning of associated enterprise.
legal_units.text: one or more persons who participate, directly or indirectly, or through one or more intermediaries, in management or control or capital of one enterprise, also participate, directly or indirectly, or through one or more intermediaries, in the management or control or capital of the other enterprise; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 162 Meaning of associated enterprise. Section 162(1): For the purposes of this Chapter, the expression "associated enterprise", in relation to another enterprise, means an enterprise— Section 162(1)(a): which participates, directly or indirectly, or through one or more intermediaries, in the management or control or capital of the other enterprise in the following manner,— Section 162(1)(a)(i): one or more persons who participate, directly or indirectly, or through one or more intermediaries, in management or control or capital of one enterprise, also participate, directly or indirectly, or through one or more intermediaries, in the management or control or capital of the other enterprise; or

legal_units.title: Meaning of associated enterprise.
legal_units.text: one enterprise holds, at any time during the tax year, directly or indirectly, shares carrying not less than 26% of the voting power in the other enterprise; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 162 Meaning of associated enterprise. Section 162(1): For the purposes of this Chapter, the expression "associated enterprise", in relation to another enterprise, means an enterprise— Section 162(1)(a): which participates, directly or indirectly, or through one or more intermediaries, in the management or control or capital of the other enterprise in the following manner,— Section 162(1)(a)(ii): one enterprise holds, at any time during the tax year, directly or indirectly, shares carrying not less than 26% of the voting power in the other enterprise; or

legal_units.title: Meaning of associated enterprise.
legal_units.text: any person or enterprise holds, at any time during the tax year, directly or indirectly, shares carrying not less than 26% of the voting power in each of such enterprises; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 162 Meaning of associated enterprise. Section 162(1): For the purposes of this Chapter, the expression "associated enterprise", in relation to another enterprise, means an enterprise— Section 162(1)(a): which participates, directly or indirectly, or through one or more intermediaries, in the management or control or capital of the other enterprise in the following manner,— Section 162(1)(a)(iii): any person or enterprise holds, at any time during the tax year, directly or indirectly, shares carrying not less than 26% of the voting power in each of such enterprises; or

legal_units.title: Meaning of associated enterprise.
legal_units.text: which has advanced a loan to the other enterprise and such loan constitutes not less than 51% of the book value of the total assets of the other enterprise; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 162 Meaning of associated enterprise. Section 162(1): For the purposes of this Chapter, the expression "associated enterprise", in relation to another enterprise, means an enterprise— Section 162(1)(b): which has advanced a loan to the other enterprise and such loan constitutes not less than 51% of the book value of the total assets of the other enterprise; or

legal_units.title: Meaning of associated enterprise.
legal_units.text: which guarantees not less than 10% of the total borrowings of the other enterprise; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 162 Meaning of associated enterprise. Section 162(1): For the purposes of this Chapter, the expression "associated enterprise", in relation to another enterprise, means an enterprise— Section 162(1)(c): which guarantees not less than 10% of the total borrowings of the other enterprise; or

legal_units.title: Meaning of associated enterprise.
legal_units.text: whose more than half of the board of directors or members of the governing board, or one or more executive directors or executive members of the governing board, are appointed by the other enterprise; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 162 Meaning of associated enterprise. Section 162(1): For the purposes of this Chapter, the expression "associated enterprise", in relation to another enterprise, means an enterprise— Section 162(1)(d): whose more than half of the board of directors or members of the governing board, or one or more executive directors or executive members of the governing board, are appointed by the other enterprise; or

legal_units.title: Meaning of associated enterprise.
legal_units.text: whose more than half of the directors or members of the governing board, or one or more of the executive directors or members of the governing board, are appointed by the same person or persons, who has or have done so for the other enterprise; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 162 Meaning of associated enterprise. Section 162(1): For the purposes of this Chapter, the expression "associated enterprise", in relation to another enterprise, means an enterprise— Section 162(1)(e): whose more than half of the directors or members of the governing board, or one or more of the executive directors or members of the governing board, are appointed by the same person or persons, who has or have done so for the other enterprise; or

legal_units.title: Meaning of associated enterprise.
legal_units.text: in case of which, manufacturing or processing of goods or articles or business carried out by such enterprise is wholly dependent on the use of know-how, patents, copyrights, trademarks, licences, franchises or any other business or commercial rights of similar nature, or any data, documentation, drawing or specification relating to any patent, invention, model, design, secret formula or process, of which the other enterprise is the owner or in respect of which the other enterprise has exclusive rights; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 162 Meaning of associated enterprise. Section 162(1): For the purposes of this Chapter, the expression "associated enterprise", in relation to another enterprise, means an enterprise— Section 162(1)(f): in case of which, manufacturing or processing of goods or articles or business carried out by such enterprise is wholly dependent on the use of know-how, patents, copyrights, trademarks, licences, franchises or any other business or commercial rights of similar nature, or any data, documentation, drawing or specification relating to any patent, invention, model, design, secret formula or process, of which the other enterprise is the owner or in respect of which the other enterprise has exclusive rights; or

legal_units.title: Meaning of associated enterprise.
legal_units.text: in case of which, 90% or more of the raw materials and consumables required for the manufacture or processing of goods or articles carried out by such enterprise, are supplied by the other enterprise, or by persons specified by the other enterprise, and the prices and other conditions relating to the supply are influenced by such other enterprise; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 162 Meaning of associated enterprise. Section 162(1): For the purposes of this Chapter, the expression "associated enterprise", in relation to another enterprise, means an enterprise— Section 162(1)(g): in case of which, 90% or more of the raw materials and consumables required for the manufacture or processing of goods or articles carried out by such enterprise, are supplied by the other enterprise, or by persons specified by the other enterprise, and the prices and other conditions relating to the supply are influenced by such other enterprise; or

legal_units.title: Meaning of associated enterprise.
legal_units.text: in case of which, the goods or articles manufactured or processed by such enterprise, are sold to the other enterprise or to persons specified by the other enterprise, and the prices and other conditions relating thereto are influenced by such other enterprise; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 162 Meaning of associated enterprise. Section 162(1): For the purposes of this Chapter, the expression "associated enterprise", in relation to another enterprise, means an enterprise— Section 162(1)(h): in case of which, the goods or articles manufactured or processed by such enterprise, are sold to the other enterprise or to persons specified by the other enterprise, and the prices and other conditions relating thereto are influenced by such other enterprise; or

legal_units.title: Meaning of associated enterprise.
legal_units.text: which is controlled by an individual, and the other enterprise is also controlled by such individual or his relative or jointly by such individual and relative of such individual; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 162 Meaning of associated enterprise. Section 162(1): For the purposes of this Chapter, the expression "associated enterprise", in relation to another enterprise, means an enterprise— Section 162(1)(h): in case of which, the goods or articles manufactured or processed by such enterprise, are sold to the other enterprise or to persons specified by the other enterprise, and the prices and other conditions relating thereto are influenced by such other enterprise; or Section 162(1)(h)(i): which is controlled by an individual, and the other enterprise is also controlled by such individual or his relative or jointly by such individual and relative of such individual; or

legal_units.title: Meaning of associated enterprise.
legal_units.text: which is controlled by a Hindu undivided family, and the other enterprise is controlled by a member of such Hindu undivided family or by a relative of a member of such Hindu undivided family or jointly by such member and his relative; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 162 Meaning of associated enterprise. Section 162(1): For the purposes of this Chapter, the expression "associated enterprise", in relation to another enterprise, means an enterprise— Section 162(1)(j): which is controlled by a Hindu undivided family, and the other enterprise is controlled by a member of such Hindu undivided family or by a relative of a member of such Hindu undivided family or jointly by such member and his relative; or

legal_units.title: Meaning of associated enterprise.
legal_units.text: which is a firm, association of persons or body of individuals, and the other enterprise holds not less than 10% interest in such firm, association of persons or body of individuals; or
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 162 Meaning of associated enterprise. Section 162(1): For the purposes of this Chapter, the expression "associated enterprise", in relation to another enterprise, means an enterprise— Section 162(1)(k): which is a firm, association of persons or body of individuals, and the other enterprise holds not less than 10% interest in such firm, association of persons or body of individuals; or

legal_units.title: Meaning of associated enterprise.
legal_units.text: which has any relationship of mutual interest with the other enterprise, as may be prescribed.
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 162 Meaning of associated enterprise. Section 162(1): For the purposes of this Chapter, the expression "associated enterprise", in relation to another enterprise, means an enterprise— Section 162(1)(l): which has any relationship of mutual interest with the other enterprise, as may be prescribed.

legal_units.title: Meaning of associated enterprise.
legal_units.text: In relation to a specified domestic transaction entered into by an assessee, associated enterprise shall also include—
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 162 Meaning of associated enterprise. Section 162(2): In relation to a specified domestic transaction entered into by an assessee, associated enterprise shall also include—

legal_units.title: Meaning of associated enterprise.
legal_units.text: other units or undertakings or businesses of such assessee in respect of a transaction referred to in section 122 or 140(9);
legal_units.retrieval_text: Section 162 Meaning of associated enterprise. Section 162(2): In relation to a specified domestic transaction entered into by an assessee, associated enterprise shall also include— Section 162(2)(a): other units or undertakings or businesses of such assessee in respect of a transaction referred to in section 122 or 140(9);

legal_units.text: any other person referred to in section 140(13) or 205(4) in respect of a transaction referred to therein; and to in Chapter VIII, to which the provisions of section 140(9) or (13) of this Act or section 80-IA(8) or (10) of the Income-tax Act, 1961 (43 of 1961) are applicable.]
